source: JRC89037 (2014) 'Eurocode 2: Background & Applications, Design of concrete buildings - worked examples', 4.2.1 Detailing of footing B-2, pp. 107-112 (R-EC2-JRC-EXAMPLES)

discrepancies.note: The report forms σ_Ed = N_Ed/(B L) = 1445 kN/m² from the column force alone and then deducts the base self-weight (1.35 × 25 × 0.8 kN/m²) to get σ'_Ed = 1418 kN/m². With N_Ed excluding the base's weight, the net pressure that bends the base is 1445 kN/m²; the deduction is only consistent if σ_Ed includes the self-weight. The workbench uses the column force alone (net pressure). The report's 9.8.2.2 arithmetic is reconciled from its own σ'_Ed.

The report concludes l_b + c_nom = 400 mm ≤ x_min = 400 mm for Ø16. Unrounded, l_b = 500 × 1071.0/1486.1 = 360.3 mm, so l_b + c_nom = 400.3 mm exceeds x_min by 0.3 mm. The workbench applies 9.8.2.2(5) unrounded, so this arrangement needs a bend or a deeper base.
